Title: Wagtail: Improper restriction handling on descendant collections in Documents and Images API
Description: The Documents and Images [API V2](https://docs.wagtail.org/en/stable/advanced_topics/api/index.html) incorrectly listed items in descendants of private collections, which should inherit the view restrictions defined on their ancestors. A user with access to the API could see the filename and name of documents and images in these descendant collections.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 7.0.9, all versions starting from 7.1.0 before 7.3.4, all versions starting from 7.4.0 before 7.4.3, all versions starting from 8.0.0-rc.1 before 8.0.0-rc.2
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 7.0.9 before 7.1.0, all versions starting from 7.3.4 before 7.4.0, all versions starting from 7.4.3 before 8.0.0-rc.1, all versions starting from 8.0.0-rc.2
